scope: Foreground approach flags, joint moss and physical bedding contact; accepted343 lanterns and architecture/camera retained.
method: Reference-led shared 6-subcell paving graph packed into unequal broad flags with shared paired meandering boundaries and real staggered T-junctions; no image-based displacement.

geometry.edgeConstruction: Narrow irregular chamfer planes, darker damp side reflectance; broad rounded rim removed.

materials.author: Amal Kumar
materials.waterFilm: Rough discontinuous water film under retained scene lighting and physical IOR1.333; physical hollow masks and authored dampness, no baked light.

limits: Joint contours are a single-view numeric interpretation; thickness, fracture and weathering are authored inference.
Native actual render comparison is required; closed/finite geometry does not establish photographic fidelity.
revisionChange: R02 shared paired T-joint graph retained exactly. Narrower flatter chamfers and restrained 2–4mm face relief replace pale bread-like rims and uniform crumpled normal response.
